title: Option A PR 3: use today's live counts (725 and 550), and also switch the Grok helper off?
detail: The brief said 704 items assigned to the retired Grok helper and 508 returns waiting for review. control/SHARED_HELPER_WORK.json on main now has 725 Grok ASSIGNED items, and the count is still rising. It also has 550 RETURNED_PENDING_REVIEW (Claude 332, Grok 218). control/ENRICHMENT_HELPER_WORK.json holds 639 more returns. The Grok provider is still marked available: true, so new work keeps going to it.
blocks: PR 3 (reassignment and processing the returns). PR 2, the Claude helper schedule, is waiting on the same go-ahead.
options: Use the live counts at PR time and set Grok available: false
Use the live counts but leave Grok available
Hold until the counts are rechecked
recommended: Use the live counts and set Grok available: false. Otherwise new items keep going to the retired helper after the reassignment.
action: Answer in chat; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
